twitter.description: Written directly by the live Angular form and by the schema's original naming.

x.description: Written by the new builder block (X/Twitter rebrand). Kept alongside 'twitter'.

blockLayout.description: The shared per-block box-model object. Named blockLayout, not layout, because this block's 'layout' already means its icon/label variant (above) and is persisted on live records — renaming that key would need a data migration. resolveBlockLayout in qcg-frontend-next reads this block's box model from here.

transparent.description: Drop the fill behind each share button, leaving only its border. Distinct from layout.transparent, which is the whole block's surface.

tracking.description: Extend event tracking core and add additional property. see: https://json-schema.org/understanding-json-schema/structuring.html#id5
